scope: Trader lifecycle M1 factual integrity (AL-05 through AL-08), not M2/M3 or performance validation

targeted.command: uv run pytest tests/test_trader_lifecycle_m1.py tests/test_decision_learning_integrity.py tests/test_trade_review.py tests/test_handbook.py tests/test_day_record.py tests/test_entry_pricing.py tests/test_session_facts.py tests/test_morning_position_calls.py tests/test_kernel_clock.py -q --no-header

full_suite.warning_detail: Existing test_build_lock multithreaded multiprocessing fork deprecation warnings

source_verification.method: Compared every entry in the successful runner's verified-files.json with local SHA-256 and git hash-object
source_verification.plan_handling: The tested in-progress plan is replaced by a completed delivery record; this verification JSON is added separately

initial_validation_findings.finding: Historical-review fixture omitted the simulated write date; it now explicitly supplies as_of=_START without weakening production availability checks
The same fixture asserted the old giveback wording; it now asserts non-achievable peak-gap labeling and exclusion of legacy extrema from held-period aggregates

important_semantics.review_attempts: At most one logical interpretation attempt per processing day, three total; provider transport retries remain separate
important_semantics.missing_model: Facts are saved, no attempt is consumed, no completed interpretation is claimed
important_semantics.availability: Conservative processing-day visibility; not a minute-level point-in-time guarantee
important_semantics.extrema: Actual fills plus strictly interior daily bars; unknown boundary-day paths excluded, achievable_exit remains unknown
important_semantics.memory: Persistent and isolated by run, trader, exchange day and security; a prior view is not a trading filter
important_semantics.existing_rules: Not automatically cleared or validated by these repairs

not_verified: User's original seven local historical runs
Real model responses to revised prompts
Minute-level executable exits or complete historical data availability
Profitability, improved drawdown, or out-of-sample alpha
M2 unified decision engine and experiments
M3 end-to-end behavioral evolution and promotion
